case_title.quote: HARILAL ETC. v. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH (NOW CHHATTISGARH)

number_of_accused.quote: the appeals of Harilal and Parasram @ Rangnath (the appellants herein) were dismissed
number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants' liability is decided; the third accused's appeal abated.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for the accused.

victim_gender.quote: Ellahabadiya alias Vijay (the deceased)... his involvement with a lady

victim_age.reason: No age is given for the victim.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: no clear cut motive proved against the accused except that there was some incident concerning a lady of the village
accused_victim_relationship.reason: No defined relationship between the accused and the victim is described.

offence_category.reason: The charge was murder under s.302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.quote: imprisonment for life under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: assaulted the deceased with sticks (danda) but in his deposition in Court he stated that the accused had assaulted the deceased with lathi
weapon.reason: Lathi, with PW-6's earlier statement of danda.

evidence_type.quote: ocular account... medical evidence... discovery of blood-stained lathi and clothes
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and recovery evidence were led.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted by the court.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicting and sentencing the appellants to imprisonment for life under Section 302
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court order of 13.07.1991.

high_court_outcome.quote: the appeals of Harilal and Parasram @ Rangnath... were dismissed
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeals on 17.02.2010.

final_outcome.quote: The appellants are acquitted of the charge
final_outcome.reason: Appeals were allowed and the accused acquitted.

neutral_facts.quote: Lathis and clothes were said to have been recovered
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate, anonymised summary that stops before court proceedings and does not reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the punishment prescribed for s.302.

attempt_completion.quote: Cause of death - Shock due to injuries in the brain and lungs.
attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: Fractures on 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th ribs on both sides.

number_of_offences.reason: Only s.302 IPC was charged and no conviction stands.

premeditation_planning.quote: strong probability of the killing being a consequence of mob action
premeditation_planning.reason: No planning found; mob action was probable.

motive.quote: no clear cut motive proved against the accused except that there was some incident concerning a lady of the village
motive.reason: Alleged motive is correctly marked as not proved.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: we do not consider seizure of lathi and clothes from the accused as a clinching circumstance
key_evidence_accepted.reason: No evidence was relied on to convict.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW-2: unsafe to rely on (chance witness, inconsistent, inculpated only Harilal). PW-6: chance witness, inconsistent with prior statement, not of stellar quality, left gaps; his non-intervention was seen as natural in mob violence. PW-9's testimony was given significance.
witness_credibility.quote: where villagers in general, and none in specific, assault a person... it is quite natural for by-standers not to intervene.
witness_credibility.reason: The 'conduct did not inspire confidence' point was the appellants' argument; the Court treated PW-6's conduct as consistent with a mob attack.

post_offence_conduct.quote: discovery of lathi and clothes at the instance of Parasram was disclosed from his house
post_offence_conduct.reason: Alleged recoveries, not treated as clinching.

custody_duration.quote: have served over 10 years of sentence during the course of the trial / appeal
custody_duration.reason: This appears only as a defence submission.

bail_history.quote: reported to have been released on bail during the pendency of this appeal

legal_representation.quote: D. N. Goburdhun, Sr. Adv., Aakarsh Kamra, Ms. Gauri Goburdhun, Advs. for the Appellants.

procedural_irregularity.quote: neither the trial court nor the High Court have carefully considered the deposition of PW-9

appeal_history.reason: Outcome at each level is correct.

prosecution_argument.quote: the villagers guarded the body entire night and next day morning FIR was lodged

defence_argument.quote: conviction under Section 304 Part-I I.P.C. would serve the ends of justice
defence_argument.reason: Accurate summary of the defence arguments.

legal_principle_applied.quote: When an FIR is delayed, in absence of proper explanation, the courts must be on guard

other_sentence_order.quote: Their bail bonds are discharged. They need not surrender.
